snippet.title: ARKONA - Intro | Project introduction
snippet.description:
Game intro / trailer for Gothic 2 modification called Arkona.
Trailer was created by  @badamb401 
Modification is being developed by David "Triber" Rusnák & Adam "BadamB" Benešovský

Voiceover part 1 - Samuel Kirk
Voiceover part 2 - Christopher Cosby

Expected modification release - Q1 - Q2 2024
Discord - https://discord.gg/j3hD7dgZsX
